newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Presidents of Russia, Ukraine to meet on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Presidents of Russia, Ukraine to meet on Thursday.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin and Ukraine's President Leonid Kuchma will hold a working meeting on Thursday, Yeltsin's press service said on Monday.
It gave no further details but the meeting is expected to take place at the Barvikha sanatorium near Moscow where Yeltsin is now resting ahead of planned heart surgery next month.
Relations between the two ex-Soviet republics have long been dogged by a dispute over control of the Black Sea Fleet that has prevented them from signing a friendship treaty.
However Ukraine firmly supported Yeltsin's re-election bid in July against his communist opponent Gennady Zyuganov.
